tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search VailVacay business listings by keyword and/or category. Returns sanitized public listings (name, description, address, phone, hours, photos, booking links). Only quality listings are returned: publicly active, with a real description (100+ chars), at least one photo, and geo coordinates.
